verdict.rationale: Maritime runs agents from any Docker image in its own micro-VM, so packages and arbitrary code can be baked in at build time via the Dockerfile (maritime-docs-1, maritime-docs-19, maritime-docs-29, maritime-docs-37). It also offers persistent Linux desktops driven by keyboard and mouse (maritime-docs-5, maritime-docs-50). However, the evidence never documents a direct exec or shell-command interface for running commands or installing packages at runtime. Missing for 10: a documented runtime shell or exec API, explicit runtime package-install support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
